summary: Migrated the active registry from ~/.pi/agent/extensions-src/ to ~/.gizmo/registries/, verified the agent-server WebSocket endpoint (ws://127.0.0.1:8787/agent) returns the expected registry status and extensions.web bundles with no diagnostics, and confirmed non-interactive registry builds work without a terminal.
decisions: Switched the registry home from ~/.pi/agent/extensions-src/ to ~/.gizmo/registries/, with the new manifest at ~/.gizmo/registries/installed.json.
Repointed Pi backend junctions (~/.pi/agent/extensions/*) and refreshed browser-bundle symlinks (~/.pi/agent/extension-web/*.web.js) to the new registry location.
Made registry builds non-interactive/CI-safe so they no longer require a terminal.
errors: Initial Get-NetTCPConnection on LocalPort 8787 returned no MSFT_NetTCPConnection objects (server hadn't bound yet), but a subsequent restart via Start-Process with --filter @gizmo/agent-server exec tsx src/server.ts succeeded and the server logged 'Pi Web server listening on ws://127.0.0.1:8787/agent'.
